text.card: A red giant 3,041 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.36 solar masses and 11.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,923 K at its surface.
